name: customer_objection_themes
description: Objections customers raised, grouped into themes, split by won and lost. Only requirements the extraction marked as an objection. Use for 'what do customers object to', 'what objections come up on lost deals', 'do architects object to different things than homeowners', 'which objections kill deals'. buyer_type and product_type are nullable dimensions taken from the FIRST value in the deal's list — a deal tagged as both Contractor and Architect is counted once, under Contractor, so these columns describe the deal's primary type rather than every type it carries. Do not present them as a complete breakdown by type. An objection appearing on won deals is not a problem — people buy after objecting; what matters is the lost-to-won ratio within a theme, not its raw count.

params.name: objection
params.description: Only objection themes matching this text, e.g. 'price', 'lead time'.

params.name: buyer_type
params.description: The deal's primary buyer type, lowercase — homeowner, contractor, architect.

params.name: product_type
params.description: The deal's primary product type, lowercase.

params.name: min_deals
params.description: Only objections raised on at least this many deals.

params.name: min_lost
params.description: Only objections appearing on at least this many lost or abandoned deals.
